display.purpose: Fluid desktop headings; 32px and line-height 1.2 at widths up to 700px.

title.purpose: Default section headings; result/dialog titles override to 20px, weight 500.

instruction.purpose: 17px desktop instruction textarea; 16px at widths up to 700px.

label.purpose: 11px visible type floor, including mobile metadata and labels.

data.purpose: 11px Consolas for actual serialized data and payloads.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button scale(0.98) press; background and border separately use 160ms ease.

motion.name: entry
motion.purpose: WAAPI reveal: opacity .55 → 1, translateY(6px) → 0, fill backwards. Results, rules, dialogs and AI explanations.

motion.name: completed-step-stagger
motion.purpose: Four completed step icons reveal after execution with 0/45/90/135ms delays; completed-result feedback, not progress.

motion.name: pipeline-state
motion.purpose: Pipeline fill, border, icon opacity and label color.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Skip WAAPI entries and stagger; remove button transforms; retain 100ms button color/border and navigation/pipeline feedback.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: horizontal navigation, 20px gutters, two-column rules/date full width, stacked supporting content.

breakpoints.name: single-column-workbench
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: hide execution explainer; retain all workflow controls.

breakpoints.name: compact-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: 196px sidebar, 190px explainer, 24px gap, 28px gutters, stacked run bar.

breakpoints.name: wide-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: 264px explainer, 56px gap and main top padding.

narrative.overview: A black, minimalist working surface puts the instruction, editable rules, source boundary and execution together. Secondary views hold saved plans, source inspection and evidence. The hierarchy comes from typography, spacing and quiet boundaries; motion explains feedback and state changes.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome surfaces and a light primary action.
Compact supporting information with readable type.
Stable navigation and purposeful, brief motion.
Explicit source, execution and disclosure boundaries.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Use text, shape and contrast to communicate status; status never depends on color alone. Avoid decorative color.

rules.name: The Readable Metadata Rule
rules.body: Keep visible text at or above the shipped (11px) floor when extending this workspace.

dos: **Do** keep visible text at or above 11px, including mobile metadata and serialized data.
**Do** use monochrome contrast, text-bearing statuses and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** preserve workflow controls when the execution explainer is hidden.
**Do** treat step reveals as feedback for an already completed run and respect reduced motion.
**Do** distinguish browser-local execution, backend persistence and approved remote AI disclosure.
donts: **Don't** add decorative color, shadows, gradients or idle animation.
**Don't** present fictional records as customer data or GPU telemetry as acceleration.
**Don't** imply that browser-reported evidence is independently attested or that signature presence verifies a receipt.
**Don't** imply source rows or drafts are uploaded when only aggregate run evidence and a source hash are persisted.
